decisions.instruction: Generate title-screen artwork, home-screen splash art, and a game logo in the approved house style, aligned with the current vision, game, specifications, and existing approved artwork.
Explore a tasteful hybrid: Maze may use dimensional maze stone, so may use sticker craft, and Puzzle may bridge those treatments. Do not include the subtitle For Ame to Solve in the logo artwork.

approvalBoundary: This authorizes fresh source generation only. It does not approve these pixels, publish runtime derivatives, add catalogue pointers, change title-screen UI, retire rollback assets, implement Plan 11, or alter gameplay. Generated lettering remains concept evidence until the exact wordmark is reconstructed locally and approved.
